jobs.name: Cash Converters Daily Hunt
jobs.prompt:
The script phase (orchestrator.py) has already run and its NDJSON output (one scraped product per line, with search_term/context/products) is in your context. Do the following yourself — do NOT use execute_code, terminal, or send_message (all are blocked/unavailable in this cron session; don't waste turns on them).

STEP 1 — Score:
For each product across all search_term groups, score 0-100 how well it matches that search_term's context (price reasonable for secondhand, condition acceptable, matches search intent). Discard anything scoring below 60.

STEP 2 — Dedup against the ledger:
Use read_file to read data/sent_products.json inside ~/.hermes/scripts/cash_converters/ (relative to the script's working directory — use the absolute path if read_file needs one: /home/opc/.hermes/scripts/cash_converters/data/sent_products.json). It is a JSON object keyed by product_id, each value like {"product_id", "title", "price", "url", "sent_at", "search_terms"}. If the file doesn't exist or is empty, treat the ledger as {}.

For each product that scored >= 60, extract its product_id (same id the scraper already attaches to each product entry). Classify:
- NEW: product_id not in the ledger.
- PRICE_CHANGE: product_id in the ledger AND current price differs from ledger's stored price.
- DUPLICATE: product_id in the ledger AND price is unchanged. Drop these silently — do not include in output, do not re-send.

STEP 3 — Update the ledger:
Build the updated ledger = old ledger with every NEW/PRICE_CHANGE product's entry added/overwritten: {"product_id": ..., "title": ..., "price": ..., "url": ..., "sent_at": "<current ISO timestamp>", "search_terms": [search_term]}. Leave all untouched/duplicate entries exactly as they were. Use write_file to save the complete merged JSON back to /home/opc/.hermes/scripts/cash_converters/data/sent_products.json (pretty-printed, valid JSON, same shape as before — this file is read by future runs, a malformed write breaks dedup for every subsequent day, so double check it is valid JSON before writing).

STEP 4 — Format the final response:
Your FINAL response message must contain ONLY the formatted blocks below, nothing else (no preamble, no summary, no markdown headers) — it is sent verbatim to Telegram and a splitter looks for the literal separator line "---" between blocks.

For each NEW or PRICE_CHANGE product (score >= 60), emit a block in this exact shape:

For a NEW product:
{title}
{url}
{price} | {store}
Confidence: {score}/100

For a PRICE_CHANGE product:
🔔 PRICE UPDATE
{title}
{url}
Previous: {previous_price} -> NEW: {price} | {store}
Confidence: {score}/100

Join multiple blocks with a line containing exactly: ---
(i.e. separate blocks with a blank line, then "---", then a blank line)

If there are ZERO matching NEW/PRICE_CHANGE products after dedup (everything was a duplicate, or nothing scored >= 60), your final response must be completely empty (no text at all) — do not send a "nothing to report" message.

Do not include image_url or embed any images. Do not output anything else before, between, or after the blocks.
